from copy import deepcopy
from civiclab.common import canonical_hash
from civiclab.e02 import wrapper_crossmodel_slot46_v2 as p
from civiclab.e02 import wrapper_crossmodel_slot46_v2_owner as m

def assemble_packet(*,owner_id,closed_expected_head,historical_price_release,
                    run_id,valid_from_utc,valid_until_utc,independent_review):
    # Invoke only after independent implementation review. No IO to real owner,
    # no credential/network, no namespace creation, no inferred live authority.
    p.need(canonical_hash(closed_expected_head)==m.EXPECTED_HEAD_SHA256,
           'exact captured1189 head required')
    q={'kind':'WRAPPER_SLOT46_PACKET_V2','owner_id':owner_id,
       'parent_key':p.identity(owner_id),'expected_head':deepcopy(closed_expected_head),
       'parent_binding':deepcopy(m.ANCHOR),'run_id':run_id,
       'valid_from_utc':valid_from_utc,'valid_until_utc':valid_until_utc,
       'bounds':deepcopy(p.BOUNDS),'code_hash':canonical_hash(p.contract())}
    q['price_release']={role:p.lease_preserved_semantics(
        historical_price_release[role],
        expected_release_hash=canonical_hash(historical_price_release[role]),
        valid_from=valid_from_utc,valid_until=valid_until_utc)
        for role in ('A','B')}
    q['authority']={'kind':p.AUTHORITY,'scope_hash':canonical_hash(q)}
    # Independent reviewer supplies the actual review identifier and hash for
    # this exact q. Do not fill an authored dummy review ID as live evidence.
    p.closed(independent_review,('kind','reviewer_role','review_id','inputs_hash'))
    p.need(independent_review['inputs_hash']==canonical_hash(q),
           'independent review must bind exact fresh draft')
    q['review']=deepcopy(independent_review)
    return p.validate_packet(q,canonical_hash(q))
